```sql
SELECT u.DisplayName, u.Location
FROM main."users" u
WHERE u."Id" IN (
    SELECT a.OwnerUserId
    FROM main."posts" q
    JOIN main."posts" a ON a."Id" = q."AcceptedAnswerId"
    WHERE q."PostTypeId" = 1
    AND a."PostTypeId" = 2
    AND a."CreaionDate" >= '2013-06-01'
    AND a."CreaionDate" < '2013-07-01'
    GROUP BY a.OwnerUserId
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 10
)
```
